meta.title: Florian Palvadeau, Full-stack Software Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Florian Palvadeau, a full-stack software engineer open to positions in Switzerland.

home.tagline: I design, build and run web applications in TypeScript, from enterprise integrations to the ticketing platform of a race I founded.

intro.statement: I build reliable web software, from enterprise integrations to products I run myself.
intro.aside: Since 2022 I have worked in TypeScript, between large-scale internal tooling at JCDecaux and the ticketing platform of a race I founded. Available from September 2027 for roles in Geneva and the canton of Vaud.

paragraphs: I am a full-stack software engineer, mostly working with TypeScript, React, Next.js and NestJS. I started in 2022 as a developer at Neurones IT, then joined JCDecaux, first as an apprentice and, since September 2025, as a software engineer in IT industrialization.

At JCDecaux I build and run internal tools that are deployed internationally, working in English with local teams. I studied digital project management at IIM, and I enjoy the part of engineering where requirements, planning and delivery meet.
Alongside, I founded Overbound, an obstacle-course race. Its first edition in September 2026 brought together more than 320 participants and 60 volunteers, with a ticketing platform I built myself.

jcdecaux.summary: Internal automation and deployment tooling used internationally (React, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes).

overbound.summary: Obstacle-course race and its ticketing platform (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, Sanity).

apprentice.summary: Two applications used daily by more than 1,000 colleagues, built as microservices with CI/CD.

neurones.summary: SaaS platform to manage Microsoft 365 environments for large-account clients (Django, Vue.js).
